entries.summary: The user encountered a minor label mismatch in several surfaces.
The required submit action remained unavailable at the task blocker.
The verifier recorded the broad label mismatch after recovery.

candidate_findings.title: Labels vary across task surfaces
candidate_findings.issue: A low-impact label mismatch appears across several surfaces.
candidate_findings.root_cause: A shared label differs between task surfaces.
fixes: Align the low-impact labels during routine content maintenance.
candidate_findings.severity_justification: The mismatch is broad but the recorded outcome is recoverable.

candidate_findings.title: The required security task is blocked
candidate_findings.issue: The required security task cannot be completed at the submit step.
candidate_findings.impact: A critical account-protection task cannot reach completion.
candidate_findings.root_cause: The required submit action is unavailable in the security surface.
fixes: Restore an available submit action and verify the completed state before release.
candidate_findings.severity_justification: One recorded task step blocks a required account-protection outcome.
